title: The Star That Cannot Be Seen

lines.en: With a buzz, the smartphone inside my coat vibrated.
「Every story began the moment he read that novel.」
Sentences appearing on the smartphone.
The vast wall before me looked very much like the phone's screen.
From Yoo Joonghyuk's third round to his 1863rd. A wall that probably contained every story I knew.
「While working on the QA team, Kim Dokja had once wondered, ‘What would happen if I were the only one who knew about this bug?’」

When I turned around, Han Sooyoung was there. She seemed to want to say something, but couldn't seem to find the right words. The bandage on her clenched left hand was gradually coming apart. It held the protection of the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.’

I carefully examined my companions one by one. Jung Heewon knelt, her trembling hands braced against the floor, while Lee Hyunsung held the unconscious Lee Gilyoung. Lee Seolhwa and Gong Pildu supported each other as they came out of the Ark.
In the distance, I could see Jang Hayoung, who had barely escaped the cabin with the masters.
“······Ajusshi.”
Shin Yoosung, looking down at her palm. It was more a murmur than a call to me. A scale fragment from the ‘Chimera Dragon’ lay in the child's hand.
Yoo Sangah's hand touched her shoulder. Feeling the tremors of her sobbing, Yoo Sangah silently looked back at the entrance we had come through.
「The stars they knew had set.」
My vision swam with dizziness. I couldn't feel the stars' gazes. Was it because every star had perished?
It couldn't be. This was only because the Great Dokkaebis were gone. Because all the Bureau's channels had suffered a tremendous blow and were malfunctioning.
「If I didn't believe that, I couldn't move forward.」

Staggering, I barely regained my balance and finally caught sight of Yoo Joonghyuk. Dead Great Dokkaebis were impaled on his Black Heavenly Demon Sword. Dead constellations' Stories dripped from its tip.
With the same expression as always, he was looking at me.
「Was this the ending you wanted?」
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ shakes violently!]
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ activates more strongly!]
I slowly opened my mouth, then closed it again.
[Completion of the final scenario is imminent.]
The Ark's inner core, which I had been searching for all this time, was rolling around before me.
A mineral glowing a brilliant yellow.
An essence in which the power of countless ‘Giant Stories’ drifting through this worldline had condensed.
[Ark's Inner Core].
The energy source of the ‘Final Ark,’ a Giant Story weapon.
If I destroyed it, the 99th scenario we had fought through would end, too.
[The <Star Stream>'s final Story is nearing completion!]
Tssss······!
My steps suddenly stopped. Vines rising from the floor had seized my ankles. ‘Zarathustras’ who had appeared from somewhere were casting control skills on me.
Selena Kim's face as she averted her gaze, seemingly apologetic. Then the prophet's voice reached me.
“You've saved us some trouble, Demon King of Salvation.”
Anna Croft was looking at me, the Ark's inner core already in her hand.
「A human hero who dreamed of a different ending from Kim Dokja's.」
“You're not very surprised, are you? I'll be taking the core.”
I had already heard about the world she dreamed of.
‘Complete Night.’ She dreamed of freedom from every constellation's gaze, and that dream was to migrate safely to another worldline with this worldline's incarnations.
But.
“The Ark is already broken.”
“We can rebuild it.”
Anna Croft looked back at the ruined Ark.
It was already damaged beyond any possibility of reuse.
But she hadn't given up hope.
“There are human incarnations skilled at making Story weapons, too. Aileen, who is with you, is one of them. And now there are no Myth-grade constellations to interfere—”
“Give me that core.”
“······I see. There was still one ‘Myth-grade constellation’ left.”
Anna Croft's eyes glowed red.

[Great Demon's Eyes]. Her power to read this world's future and past began to constrict me. Having fully awakened the eyes' power, she now possessed Status greater than that of ordinary Narrative-grade constellations.
「The adversary of every star.」
Just like the original novel. Anna Croft, who hated every constellation in this world. Who had sworn to use the stars' power to destroy the stars. To complete her night, she wouldn't let me live.
「If this story really was the same as the original.」
The point of Anna Croft's sword, aimed at me, hesitated.
“······It's not too late, Kim Dokja.”
Something that had never happened in the original novel.
Beside me, Yoo Joonghyuk gripped the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]'s hilt. I sensed his faint surprise. Anna Croft drew a small breath and began to speak.

“I······don't know what ending you're dreaming of. Even my [Future Sight] can't read that far. But I have an idea. If my [Future Sight] can't see your ending, it probably means your ending is connected to that [Final Wall]. But think carefully, Kim Dokja. About whether that path really is for the sake of all of us, for humanity.”
It was the first time she had said so much at once.
I listened silently.

“Isn't this enough? You've already suffered enough misfortune. You've lost so much, and had what you cherished mocked. You've been worn down until you can no longer distinguish joy from sorrow, and you've grown tired of stories. And yet you're still curious about this world's ‘A Single Story’? Will you put humanity's survival aside for something like that?”
Every word was desperate. Words asserting her justice and resenting mine.

Soon they became a Story. A dazzling Story enveloping ‘Anna Croft’ and the Zarathustras. It wasn't as bright or splendid as the constellations' Stories, but it was steadfast and beautiful. Every aspect of the Story they had built held their convictions.
A feeling countless stars had forgotten long ago. Because she hadn't forgotten that feeling, she had come this far.
“Kim Dokja. Give up your ■■.”
“Please. Come with me into my ‘Complete Night.’”
Several Zarathustras widened their eyes at that. No wonder. What she was proposing directly violated her own beliefs.
Anna Croft was asking me to become the one star that would light the night of a new world.
It was an offer I was grateful for. But
[I am a constellation.]
It was an offer I could never accept.
Tsssss······.
With a slight release of my Status, all the vines binding my hands and feet fell away.
As though mocking her goodwill, all my Stories began speaking.
[The Giant Story, ‘Demon Realm’s Spring,’ begins its story!]
A Demon King's horns sprouted from my head, and
[The Giant Story, ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth,’ roars!]
[Unbreakable Faith], which had killed a god, cried out fiercely, and
[The Giant Story, ‘Season of Light and Darkness,’ looks upon the human world.]
Wings gained by betraying an archangel spread, and
[The Giant Story, ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones,’ mocks the <Star Stream>.]
An ominous, evil aura of Chaos covered my entire body.
Anna Croft's eyes trembled violently. Eyes searching frantically, as though trying to find even a scrap of humanity in my appearance.
But there was something we both knew. How could a being in whom you had to struggle to find humanity be called an ordinary human?
“······Are you the same in the end, too, Demon King of Salvation?”
Anna Croft's murmur held deep sorrow. It sounded less like a dispassionate statement of fact than a voice filled with resolve.
“I will kill you here.”
Terrifying Status poured from Anna Croft. I had known she was conserving her strength all the way here.
“Even if you are a ‘Myth-grade constellation,’ you cannot stop me in that condition. Your companions don't seem to be in their right minds, either—”

Jung Heewon, Lee Hyunsung, Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung all still looked dazed. Even Han Sooyoung only watched me in silence. Those eyes, which had always believed in me, were wavering for the first time.
Perhaps that was only natural. They had watched their sponsors suffer right before their eyes.
“Let's end this.”
Around fifteen Zarathustras slipped toward Yoo Joonghyuk in an instant.
And in the next moment, Anna Croft flashed toward me, her dagger thrusting at my throat.
I calmly watched its point, then spoke.
[That's enough playing around, Loki.]
At those words, Anna Croft's movements froze.
I lightly raised a finger and pushed her dagger aside.
Shocked, Anna Croft murmured.
“Wh-what is this······?”
[A constellation who enjoys changing genders cackles.]
“Loki, you! This isn't what we agreed—!”
An enormous amount of Status pressed down on Anna Croft and the Zarathustras.
The constellation who enjoyed changing genders. ‘Loki,’ <Asgard>'s last star, was there.
None of the Zarathustras could resist Loki's power. Because Loki was the very being who had freed them from <Asgard>'s rule.
“I, for the people······!”
With those words, Anna Croft lost consciousness. The core fell from her hand, rolled across the floor and came to my feet. I picked it up.
[It's been such fun, Demon King of Salvation.]
When I straightened, a man stood before me. Green hair and a mischievous expression.
[The constellation, ‘One Who Changes His Existence,’ looks at you.]
One Who Changes His Existence.
‘Loki,’ one of <Asgard>'s highest-ranking constellations.
A constellation who had helped us many times on our way here, yet whose intentions I couldn't fathom.
He had escaped the Apocalypse Dragon's calamity unharmed and followed us.
“Thanks for your help.”
[The end of the world is right before us. We can't let a trifling human ruin everything. ······More importantly, now there's no one left to frighten, I think you can put away that scary appearance.]
I dismissed my horns and wings. Then I spoke.
“You should show your real appearance, too.”
[What do you mean?]
“Hadn't we agreed to stop acting?”
At my words, Yoo Joonghyuk, who had been watching all this time, spoke to me.
—Kim Dokja.
—You're right.
I glared at Loki.
The constellation, ‘One Who Changes His Existence.’
If I was right, this being wasn't a ‘constellation.’
[The constellation, ‘One Who Changes His Existence,’ reveals his true identity!]
[Con■stellation,■ ‘His■ ??Existence■??’······.]
A dazzling light enveloped Loki, and his appearance began to change. He grew a little shorter, and the wrinkles on his face rapidly multiplied. Then two enormous lumps grew on his cheeks.
「A being who freely exploited the <Star Stream>'s bugs. The sworn enemy of every dokkaebi in the world, and founder of the ‘Seeker of the End’ organization.」
I had met him once before.
At the Tongtian River in Journey to the West, he had fought the Great Dokkaebis who were getting in my way.
A dangerous smile rose on his faintly twisted lips.
[Yes, you aren't the only ones who dream of the <Star Stream>'s end.]
“······Wenny King.”
Recognizing him, Yoo Joonghyuk drew the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] without hesitation.
[Put it away. I have no intention of fighting you.]
The Wenny King waved a hand and spoke.
[There is only one thing I want to see. That ‘something’ beyond this Final Wall you've sought. Nothing more. And······.]
Gooooooo!
[I don't think you're in any position to worry about me right now.]
The moment I turned around, someone seized my collar. Lee Jihye's face was right before mine. Stories of anger and resentment flowing from her incarnation body battered me all over.
“······Ajusshi. What is this? Huh? Is this part of the plan, too?”
I could no longer feel the sea's spirit from Lee Jihye. I could no longer smell the faint salt scent that had come from her when I first met the girl on the subway.
“Kim Dokja!”
Lee Jihye shook me, crying. No one could stop her. Yoo Sangah, Jung Heewon, Shin Yoosung. They all kept their heads lowered, looking at the floor.
「And Kim Dokja understood how she felt.」
This resentment was entirely mine to bear.
「But there was someone who didn't think so.」
“Lee Jihye.”
「It was Han Sooyoung.」
“Let go!”

Lee Jihye reacted fiercely when Han Sooyoung took her shoulder. But Han Sooyoung didn't let go. With firm hands, she swept back Lee Jihye's bangs and wiped away her brimming tears, continuing to speak.
“Black Flame Dragon, Uriel and Maritime War God aren't dead.”
“How, how do you know that?”
“I can feel it. It's very faint, but I can definitely feel that they're alive. And.”
A voice cold yet kind, precise yet unwavering. A voice only Han Sooyoung could produce.
“Wipe your tears and take a good look. At the state of the bastard you've got by the collar right now.”
Her eyes clouded, Lee Jihye had lowered her head. Only then did she slowly look up. She hesitated for a long time, looking at me. I didn't avert my eyes, either.
Lee Jihye spoke in a trembling voice.
“Why are you crying, ajusshi······?”
The hand gripping my collar loosened. Han Sooyoung slipped into that opening and punched me in the face.
“Get a hold of yourself, idiot! Explain properly. You didn't come all this way without thinking, did you!”
Put another way, that was a threat to kill me if I had done this without thinking. Han Sooyoung asked.
“There's a way to save the sponsors, right? Right······?”
「There was no such way.」
I looked up at the sky.

The <Star Stream>'s pitch-black night sky. Many constellations' lights had gone out, but if I looked closely, some still twinkled. Stars whose faint light I could feel only after watching for a very long time.
「Kim Dokja hated the constellations. He had never forgotten that feeling, not for a moment.」
「But this world's scenarios had changed even Kim Dokja.」
I looked at the [Final Wall].
The wall where all this world's ‘Stories’ were recorded.
The wall that existed to record ‘A Single Story,’ the desire of every dokkaebi.
“It might already be too late.”
All this misfortune existed to be recorded on that wall.
No, perhaps it was the other way around.
All these things had happened ‘because they were recorded on that wall.’
“But it might be possible.”

It was impossible to change what had already happened. There was no way to revive those whose very souls had been annihilated, or erase the wounds they had suffered as though they had never existed. There was no way to save a worldline already destroyed.
This world's damned probability wouldn't allow it. That was a story like the ‘square circle’ Han Sooyoung had mentioned.
「But if such a thing were possible.」
「If a ‘Wall’ that could make a ‘square circle’ real existed in this world.」
I squeezed the core in my hand with all my strength.
[You have cleared Main Scenario #99 ― ‘Enemy of the Story’!]
[Settlement of the completion rewards begins.]
[There is currently no Great Dokkaebi to handle reward settlement.]
[Reward settlement is delayed.]
[You have earned the qualification to meet the ‘King of Stories.’]
The dazzling wall opened its mouth toward us.
[The <Star Stream> wishes to name your last Story.]
[You are given choices for your final Story.]
[The nebula <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s epic has become a final candidate for ‘A Single Story’!]
[Every star to be born in the <Star Stream> will praise your Story!]
Reading the messages appearing one after another, my companions and I took stock. Everyone still looked shocked, but this wasn't the time to stop. Suddenly, Gong Pildu spoke.
“······Does this mean the main scenarios are over?”
Unlike usual, no follow-up scenario activated after the main scenario ended. Instead, we heard a system message.
[The <Star Stream>'s main scenario system enters its shutdown sequence.]
A message I had never heard in my life.
The grand world of scenarios was finally drawing to a close.
No one seemed to know what to say.
“When this ends······what happens to the world?”
Gong Pildu stared at the wall, looking hollow. The countless sentences blooming on it scattered and gathered again, as though sensing his gaze. Some of those sentences were about him.
「A man who lost his family when the scenarios began.」
He looked tired somehow. Perhaps I was mistaken, but I thought something might be welling in his eyes. Hesitating, I spoke.
“The being who oversaw all these scenarios is still here.”
“Do we······have to take that bastard down, too?”
“If it's too much, you can stay here.”
“After all this?”
Anger rose on Gong Pildu's face.
“I can't forgive that bastard. Tearing him to pieces wouldn't be enough.”
The moment I saw his eyes, I felt as though I was the one being attacked.
Behind him, I thought I could see the Stories of ordinary people who had died in the scenarios.
「It felt as though all those Stories resented Kim Dokja.」
“He took my family and all my land. I, I will absolutely······!”
Gong Pildu collapsed, foaming blood before he could finish. Lee Seolhwa quickly caught him and checked his pulse.
“······His incarnation body is badly damaged.”

In the cabin battle, Gong Pildu had protected our companions alongside Lee Hyunsung. His prized [Armed Fortress] was wrecked. I could barely feel the Status of his sponsor, Defense Master. This was probably as far as he could fight with us.
“I'll take him. This man deserves to see the end, too, after all.”
“Please do.”
Lee Seolhwa activated her special skill, [Stretcher], and laid Gong Pildu on a bed made of a magic net.
Meanwhile, Lee Jihye and Jung Heewon had recovered enough strength to stand.
“Let's go, Dokja-ssi. Whatever we find, we have to see the end.”
I felt ashamed that Jung Heewon was the one saying that. She probably resented me more than anyone here.
A hand tapping my shoulder as she passed.
“Don't dwell on pointless thoughts. My sponsor told us, remember? That's all we've seen of the story.”
“No one knows what the next part of the story will be.”
At the cool resolve in her voice, Lee Hyunsung nodded, Lee Gilyoung on his back.
“Heewon-ssi is right.”
Shin Yoosung and Lee Jihye felt the same.
「Even after all that had happened, his companions still believed in Kim Dokja.」
Could my companions see that sentence now?
Did someone like me even deserve to read a sentence like that?
Tssssss······!
[Would you like to enter the ‘Final Wall’?]
At last, a message appeared.
Sparks of probability surged across the wall. Around them, the wall was sinking inward. The letters on the white wall all withdrew, creating a small entrance for us.
Han Sooyoung asked doubtfully.
“······Does your plan extend beyond this, too?”
The entrance was filled with whitish mist. A mist I knew very well.
A sentence I had reread so many times I now knew it by heart.
「At last, Yoo Joonghyuk, who had lost everything, looked beyond the mist.」
That passage was the very one Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round had taken.
“······You said what happens next isn't even in ‘Ways of Survival.’”
I nodded.
Now all that remained was to enter. The last thing troubling me was······.
“······Go ahead. This is as far as ‘Zarathustra’ goes. It says we don't have permission to enter.”

Unlike Anna Croft, her followers, the ‘Zarathustras,’ didn't have many Giant Stories connected to <Kim Dokja's Company>. They watched me dejectedly for a moment, then silently stepped aside to open a path.
[The incarnation, ‘Selena Kim,’ accepts her ■■.]
[The incarnation, ‘Selena Kim,’ has the ■■ ‘Unattainable Dream.’]
—Please take care of Anna.
Selena Kim's voice, carried by voice transmission. I nodded heavily and turned away.
I heard my companions' footsteps behind me. Companions who had become one constellation. But who did not all shine in the same direction.
“Let's go.”
「Even so, everyone here had an ending they had to see for themselves.」
Then a shadow drifted through the mist before us.
Anna Croft's platinum-blond hair spreading through the air.
But it wasn't Anna Croft moving her body.
Yoo Joonghyuk gripped the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]'s hilt and kept his attention fixed on the Wenny King.
“You don't trust the Wenny King, do you?”
He hadn't lowered his guard this whole time, and kept directing killing intent at the Wenny King at every opportunity.
I didn't like Wenny men, either. They had once tried to kidnap Biyoo and had tried to cheat me in the Demon Realm.
“I don't. We've only formed a temporary alliance. I made a contract with him before.”
“A contract?”
I didn't explain in detail.
Because someone had appeared to explain instead.
[You really don't seem to trust me, regressor.]
Watching the Wenny King speak through Anna Croft's mouth, I thought there could be no worse combination. Combining the two people Yoo Joonghyuk hated.
Without a word, Yoo Joonghyuk sent magic power into the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]. He looked as though he wouldn't hesitate to use it if necessary.
[I've heard from the other Wenny men. They said you cut off my children's lumps.]
“Do you want yours cut off, too?”
The Wenny King cackled in amusement.
“What's so funny?”
[I like your unnecessary aloofness. You were like that in the Demon Realm and Murim, too. I'd been bored there for a long time, but thanks to you, I had great fun.]
“One more word and I really will cut off your lumps.”
“Hey, Yoo Joonghyuk.”
Yoo Joonghyuk seemed more agitated than usual, so I stopped him. Nothing good would come of a fight with the Wenny King here.
Why was that? His unsettled aura was unlike his usual self. Perhaps his thoughts were also tangled with the end so close.
Looking between Yoo Joonghyuk and me, the Wenny King spoke.
[You seem to be good friends.]
As Yoo Joonghyuk glared again, the Wenny King continued.
[I had someone like that, too. Someone who loved stories dearly, like that ‘Demon King of Salvation’ over there.]
“I have no interest in your stories.”

[We carried out scenarios together. We escaped death many times and fought the absolute beings who mocked us. We built Stories into Giant Stories, and Giant Stories into an epic. With that epic, we finally reached the ‘Final Wall.’]
······The ‘Wenny King’ had reached the ‘Final Wall’ before?
This information wasn't even in ‘Ways of Survival.’
[A story you've never heard, I'm sure. It no longer remains even as a Story. Perhaps only the ‘Apocalypse Dragon,’ driven mad by the repeating years, barely remembers it.]
“······Was there a <Star Stream> in your time, too?”
[It had a slightly different name then. <Star Stream> is only the name chosen after we saw this world's end.]
Beings who had seen the ‘end of the world’ before us.
What had their ■■ been like? What on earth had happened for him to remain the ‘Wenny King,’ drifting through the scenarios?
[That damned fellow is now called ‘King of Stories.’]
From beyond the mist came the cracking sound of something collapsing.
[That is why I look forward to your final chapter. I'm curious. Which of you will be this scenario's final victor—]
Tssssss······.
The mist before us shuddered all at once.
[It's about time to meet my old friend.]
With those words, the Wenny King's afterimage vanished.
But I could still hear his messages.
[You should get moving. Before you're all eaten.]
······Eaten?
“Ajusshi!”
Following us from behind, Lee Jihye gave a strangled cry and sank into the floor. Things like palms appeared from the floor and walls around us, snatching at our arms and legs.
“Jihye!”
[The character, ‘Lee Jihye,’ has become part of the great story.]
Jung Heewon reached for Lee Jihye as she was sucked into the floor. But it was already too late. Jung Heewon's body was being drawn down, too.
The wall, turned into deep quicksand, was swallowing Jung Heewon.
[The character, ‘Jung Heewon,’ has become part of the great story.]
“Heewon-ssi!”
Watching Lee Hyunsung run toward Jung Heewon, I lost my bearings for an instant.
Had this ever happened in ‘Ways of Survival’? Just what was—
「In ‘Ways of Survival,’ Yoo Joonghyuk had crossed this passage alone.」
I had overlooked that fact.
Yoo Joonghyuk had never once crossed this passage with a group.
“Everyone, gather over here!”
But it was already too late. Lee Hyunsung, Lee Seolhwa and Gong Pildu, then even Yoo Sangah and the children, were seized by the wall and sucked inside.
[The character, ‘Shin Yoosung,’ has become part of the great story.]
[The character, ‘Yoo Sangah,’ has become part of the great story.]
My heart pounded violently.
The word ‘character’ I heard amid all this grated on my nerves even more.
“Han Sooyoung! Yoo Joonghyuk!”
Yoo Joonghyuk was already half-sunk into the floor. There was no time to resist.
“Get back!”
The sword wind Yoo Joonghyuk sent pushed me away. I barely evaded the letters seizing my ankles.
[The character, ‘Yoo Joonghyuk,’ has become part of the great story.]
In the end, even Yoo Joonghyuk had been taken.
Only Han Sooyoung remained. But the wall was swallowing one of her arms, too.
“Quick, this way······!”
I pulled her with all my strength.
The power of [Way of the Wind] settled in my feet, and explosive propulsion enveloped me.
[The ‘Final Wall’ shows greed for your epic!]
[The ‘Final Wall’ looks at a person not included in its story!]
Tssssss······!
Han Sooyoung's body was trembling as though in a seizure.
「Han Sooyoung was now the only one besides him who was not a ‘character.’」
I moved my feet with all my strength. But the wall's pursuit was relentless. Worse, I didn't know where to run. Ahead, behind, beside me, above. Wherever I looked, there was nowhere to escape.
Whoosh.

With the sensation of stepping into empty air, the floor gave way. Just as it had for Lee Jihye and Jung Heewon. The wall was sucking me in. I began falling with Han Sooyoung, as though into an endless void. Whitish mist rushed in with each ragged breath, choking me.
「Kim Dokja was afraid of stories he didn't know.」
Text of overwhelming density obstructed my breathing. Stories with so many letters I couldn't even make them out. A literal ‘Giant Story’ was crushing me.
I struggled to escape that Story somehow. But the more I struggled, the deeper a vague terror burrowed into me. It felt as though everything inside me was emptying out.
Sentences were escaping through my fingertips. The Stories that made me were disappearing. Then.
「The Stories that make up who you are exist because you see, experience and feel them.」
That one sentence caught at my fingertips. It was the ‘Story Control’ Yoo Hoseong had taught me on ‘Reincarnation Island.’
「Let it know that you are watching.」
I held tight to that sentence. Then, along with it, the things that had made up the Story began surfacing in my mind one by one.
「Kim Dokja calmly steadied his breathing.」
In that boundless universe of sentences, I stopped running. The Stories opened their maws as though to devour me.
「Without you looking into them, they cannot even exist.」
There was no need to be afraid. They were only Stories.
Tssssss······!
I watched the words pouring in. To let you know that I had been reading you here. Without blinking, I stared at the sentences.
Then, in the next moment, the words scattered like mist began to gather.
「To avoid being consumed by Stories, one must become a ‘reader.’」
As though thanking the one who had discovered them, the sentences drifted around my feet. Soon they became stepping stones for me.
「One who can love Stories, yet read them without becoming intoxicated by them.」
「Only then will Stories become a means to face the formless void.」
My fall stopped.
I lightly stepped on the sentences gathering at my feet. They weren't sentences from ‘Ways of Survival.’
「“I'm Dokja.”」
「I really do introduce myself to people this way, and it often leads to the following misunderstanding.」
Even so, they were somehow familiar sentences.
Reading them, I moved forward one step at a time. Some were stories I already knew, some I didn't know well, and some I now remembered only dimly.
「When he was young, Kim Dokja had once had a thought.」
My younger self was scribbling something in a notebook. Neatly organized power-balance charts and hidden pieces from ‘Ways of Survival.’ And,
「What? I wouldn't have done it like this.」
My own walkthrough of ‘Ways of Survival.’
「Idiot. This is how you should have fought the Sea Commander. The item you needed then was—」
「The key to the Theatre Dungeon is getting the ampoules from the laboratory.」
「You have to get Ganpyeongui here. It's more important than the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword.」
With every step, the sense of déjà vu grew.
「You have to kill all the constellations. This is the only way here.」
「To become stronger without regressing······.」
「This really is the best route. You need to get the first ‘Giant Story’ in the Demon Realm.」
The sentences my younger self wrote were lighting my way.
Walking along them, I thought.
「To save everyone—」
Could this path have begun even before I could remember?
Snap.
At last, the sentence broke off.
Where it ended stood a very small white door.
The very door Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round had opened, too.
「The [Epilogue] of every story he hadn't read lay beyond it.」
I gazed down at the doorknob.
「Just to turn the handle of this door.」
All those stories that had begun with Yoo Joonghyuk flashed through my mind.
And at that moment, a question I had held for a very long time, but never spoken aloud, rose within me.
「How had tls123 wanted to depict the epilogue of ‘Ways of Survival’?」
Reaching for the doorknob, I turned back without realizing it.
A path made of distant Stories. Seen from afar, its scenery was strangely unfamiliar.
「I watched that path for a long time.」
Then the door opened.
「In the beginning, the universe was ‘One.’」
When I came to, that sentence was before me. I couldn't tell whether it was a sentence or a memory masquerading as one.
「In that world, ‘One’ was omniscient and omnipotent. ‘One’ was the universe, and the universe was ‘One.’ Within it, ‘One’ was perfect. Perfectly alone.」
Then a dazzling explosion occurred.
